notes: Colour coding: general categories have one “+ Add another” button (no suggestions); a line shows as a thin bar along the bottom of the colour square; the last column is How to display – Show, Hide or Group in Other (explained underneath)
Family groups now come before the people, with what they’re for – just a name and a colour (they’re always shown)
People: How to display – Individually, In Family, In Boys group…, or Hide
Other: a grey square, what it holds, and one tick box to display it or not
